description: New features — content data, game logic wiring, backend API endpoints. All logic-only, no visual/rendering changes.

userStories.title: Arabic idioms and proverbs dataset
userStories.description: Create src/data/arabicIdioms.js with 100+ Arabic idioms/proverbs. Each entry: Arabic text, English meaning, literal translation, usage example sentence, CEFR level (A1-C2), category, origin region. Include selectors for filtering by category and CEFR level, plus a deterministic daily idiom rotation (same date = same idiom for all players).
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/arabicIdioms.js exports array of 100+ idiom objects
Each idiom has: arabic, english, literal, example, cefrLevel, category, origin
10 categories: wisdom, social, nature, humor, work, family, patience, honor, courage, knowledge
selectIdiomsBy(category) selector works
selectDailyIdiom(dateString) returns deterministic result (same date = same idiom)
Tests: 12+ tests covering data structure, category coverage, daily rotation consistency
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Pure data file + selectors. No UI. Use a simple hash function for daily rotation (e.g., date string charcode sum % array length).

userStories.title: Arabic phonetics reference data
userStories.description: Create src/data/arabicPhonetics.js with all 28 Arabic consonants and 6 vowels. Each consonant: letter, IPA symbol, articulation point, voicing (voiced/voiceless), description. Include 15+ minimal pairs (e.g., ب/ف, ج/خ, ض/د) with example words for pronunciation practice.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/arabicPhonetics.js exports consonants array (28), vowels array (6), minimalPairs array (15+)
Each consonant has: letter, name, ipa, articulationPoint, voicing, description
Each vowel has: letter, name, ipa, type (short/long), description
Each minimal pair has: pair [letter1, letter2], examples [{arabic, english, transliteration}]
Selectors: selectConsonantsByArticulation(point), selectMinimalPairsFor(letter)
Tests: 10+ tests for data completeness and selector correctness
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Pure data file. No UI. Reference standard Arabic phonology.

userStories.title: Battle opponents database
userStories.description: Create src/data/battleOpponents.js with 30 human opponent profiles (3-4 per zone across 8 zones). Each opponent: name, zone, level, base stats (hp, attack, defense, speed), personality, Arabic dialogue lines (intro, hit, miss, defeat), weakness vocabulary, XP/gold rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: src/data/battleOpponents.js exports array of 30 opponents
Each opponent has: id, name, zone, level, stats {hp, attack, defense, speed}, personality, dialogue {intro, hit, miss, defeat} (Arabic + English), weaknessVocab [wordIds], rewards {xp, gold}
3-4 opponents per zone, 8 zones covered
Selectors: selectOpponentsByZone(zone), selectOpponentById(id)
Difficulty scales with zone order (zone 1 easiest, zone 8 hardest)
Tests: 10+ tests for data distribution, stat ranges, zone coverage
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Pure data file. Check existing zone names in the codebase. Arabic dialogue should be simple phrases appropriate to opponent personality.

userStories.title: Wire battle rewards to progression systems
userStories.description: Complete the battleRewardsMiddleware to route battle results to game systems. XP feeds skill trees, loot goes to inventory, gold to economy, defeated opponent's weakness vocabulary gets queued for FSRS review, companion participation earns companion XP.
acceptanceCriteria: battleRewardsMiddleware listens for battle end actions
XP distributed to correct skill tree based on battle type
Gold added to player economy state
Loot items added to inventory (skip if full, dispatch notification)
Weakness vocabulary from defeated opponent added to review queue
Companion XP awarded if companion participated
Tests: 12+ integration tests covering full reward chain
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check existing battleRewardsMiddleware stub. Read inventorySlice, economySlice, skillTreeSlice, and companionSlice to understand dispatch patterns.

userStories.title: Vocabulary introduction rate controller
userStories.description: Create a service/middleware that controls how many new words per day a player sees, based on their mastery of existing words. If mastery <60%: 0 new words. 60-70%: 5/day. 70-85%: 15/day. >85%: 30/day. Resets at UTC midnight.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/middleware/vocabRateMiddleware.js or similar
getNewWordRate(masteryPercent) returns words/day based on thresholds
Middleware tracks daily counter, resets at UTC midnight
When daily limit reached, new word introduction paused (dispatch action)
Selector: selectRemainingNewWords() returns how many new words left today
Tests: 14+ tests covering thresholds, day boundary reset, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check how vocabulary is currently introduced — may need to intercept an existing action.

userStories.title: Conversation practice scoring engine
userStories.description: Build scoring logic for conversation practice (Phase 84). Score player Arabic responses against expected answers: exact match=100, 1 word off=80, 2+ words off=50, completely wrong=25. Award XP and queue new vocabulary for FSRS review.
acceptanceCriteria: scoreConversationResponse(playerText, expectedText) returns 0-100 score
Scoring: exact=100, 1 word diff=80, 2 word diff=50, 3+=25
Award XP: 50 + (score * 0.5), capped at 100
Extract vocabulary from expected sentence, queue for FSRS review
Handle Arabic diacritics gracefully (compare with and without tashkeel)
Tests: 14+ tests covering scoring algorithm, XP calculation, diacritic handling
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check src/utils/ for any existing Arabic text comparison utilities. Normalize Arabic text before comparison (strip tashkeel for comparison purposes).

userStories.title: Adaptive quiz difficulty engine
userStories.description: Build a difficulty service that tracks last 50 quiz results and adjusts difficulty to target 70-85% success rate. Also suggests breaks after 10+ consecutive errors or 30+ minute sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: calculateDifficultyLevel(recentResults) returns difficulty 1-5
Targets 70-85% success rate using exponential moving average
Middleware recalculates every 5 quizzes and updates store
Break suggestion: dispatch notification after 10 consecutive errors OR 30min continuous play
Selector: selectCurrentDifficulty(), selectShouldSuggestBreak()
Tests: 14+ tests covering EMA calculation, difficulty adjustment, break detection
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Check if Phase 59 built any existing adaptive difficulty in the codebase — build on top of it, don't duplicate.

userStories.title: Crafting system vocabulary gate
userStories.description: Wire vocabulary mastery to the crafting system — players can only use crafting ingredients they've learned the Arabic word for. Recipe requires 80%+ ingredient mastery to craft.
acceptanceCriteria: canUseIngredient(ingredientId, vocabMasteryMap) checks if player has learned the word
Recipe craftable only if all ingredients at 80%+ mastery
Selector: selectCraftableRecipes() filters recipes by mastery requirement
Crafting XP scaled to average CEFR level of ingredients used
Tests: 10+ tests covering ingredient checks, recipe gating, XP scaling
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read craftingSlice.js and vocabulary data to understand the data models before implementing.

userStories.title: Leaderboard API endpoints
userStories.description: Build Express endpoints for server-side leaderboards: save scores, fetch rankings, get player's own rank. Categories: xp, wordsLearned, streak, questsCompleted.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/leaderboard/score — save score with category, value, timestamp
GET /api/leaderboard/:category?limit=50 — fetch top players
GET /api/leaderboard/my-rank/:category — authenticated, returns player rank
MongoDB schema with indexes on category + score
Zod validation on all inputs
Rate limited to 1 request per 30 seconds per user
Tests: 10+ tests covering save, rank, pagination
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Create server/src/models/Leaderboard.js and server/src/controllers/leaderboardController.js. Follow existing route patterns in server/src/routes/.

userStories.title: Player progress snapshot service
userStories.description: Build middleware + API to capture weekly snapshots of player stats for analytics. Snapshot: vocabCount, vocabMastered, cefrLevel, achievements, playtimeMinutes, zonesUnlocked. Stored in user document.

Snapshot captured and saved to user.snapshots array
GET /api/user/progress/snapshots?weeks=52 — fetch historical snapshots
Selector: selectProgressTrend(snapshots) returns data suitable for charting
Snapshots immutable once created (append-only)

npm run test:run passes
